|game_text=Deploy on a smuggler, gambler or thief. If subsequently captured by a bounty hunter and then transferred to Jabba's Palace: Dungeon, retrieve Force equal to character's forfeit (+6 if Han) and lose Effect. (Immune to Alter.)
|joke=The lore is alien speech with no translation, in which only "Chewbacca" and "Wookiee" can be read. The picture is Chewbacca with the bounty hunter Boushh, who brings him to Jabba for the bounty in ''Return of the Jedi'', a scene the film subtitles.<ref name="imsdb-rotj">[https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-Return-of-the-Jedi.html Star Wars: Return of the Jedi script], IMSDb. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260802212158/https://imsdb.com/scripts/Star-Wars-Return-of-the-Jedi.html Internet Archive], 2 August 2026.</ref> It is part of the running gag of cards that print alien speech and sounds without a translation. See [[Jokes#Alien speech and sounds|Jokes]].
